spec: D1436 (STORY v0.7.15 §8 row 7): Juniper's short beat at the Glimmer pick, new saves only
_about: Ours, not a design copy. New-flow saves (Seal 1 before the pick) never take the Bright Pavilion Tour, so at a Glimmer pick, right after the Tier 1 lanyard is handed over (side_pick in glimmer_path.json runs pick_log inside its story.seal1 branch), Associate Juniper clips the lanyard to the Fernbrook Seal, logs the Seal and takes the holder's photo for the wall beside the Sanctuary crate list. It sets story.tour1_s1, the flag the photo news reads (nw-fernbrook-wall, yo-pavilionwall), and adds 1 to story.tour_unease as the Tour's stage photo does. A save that already took the Tour (story.tour1_s1) never plays it and never gains a second point. Keepers picks never reach it. Save stays pixelpets.save.v2; both flags already ship, nothing is written at load.

_placeholders.note: PLACEHOLDER copy (Story/June to replace; OPEN_DECISIONS row D1436). Glimmerwell voice; the beat only clips, logs and takes the photo.

pick_log: Hold still, partner! Your Tier 1 Lanyard clips right onto your Fernbrook Seal. Snap!
Now I just log your Seal for the partnership file. One tap... done! Every Seal counts.
A flash! Your photo goes up on the Pavilion wall, right beside the Sanctuary crate list.
Gorgeous! Brighter by nature. Have a bright day!
